label: Label: sourced - GB 50139-2014, the design depth is the draught plus a clearance that depends on the channel class; a CEMT IV vessel is class II by tonnage, whose clearance at the strict end of the range is 0.4 m
why: The design depth is the draught plus a clearance: 2.5 m + 0.4 m = 2.9 m. The width comes from the appendix A formula.
